=== Data center comments.docx ===
September 29, 2026
Yasmen Ritchey
Bowie County Resident

To whom it may concern:
I’d like to formally document my concerns for the following data center projects coming to Bowie/Miller County. Project Big Pine, Data Hub, Black Mountain and Bentaus/Chadbourn Infrastructure partners LLC coming to Miller County (apart of Texarkana).
The proximity of these centers are as shown: 

As you can see we have 4 data centers coming to our region. Despite our efforts the commissioners and local governments are not listening to our concerns. In fact, Judge  Howell permitted to sign the sale of the land for -Black Mountain( 599 acres purchased with tax payers money and currently under an NDA) is also apart of the board for AR-TX REDI. AR-TX REDI is a local non-profit that connects businesses for economic development opportunities throughout the Texarkana region. 
Not only is Judge Howell on the board, the Mayor of Texarkana TX and AR, the City Managers of Texarkana TX , AR, and Nash, the Judge for Miller County, and New Boston SDIC are among those on the board for AR-TX REDI.
Our citizens are highly concerned about the Cities negligent behavior. We have no say in the decision making and are in the dark about the future of our community. These meeting are being held behind closed doors with NDAs signed. While it may not be illegal for them to hold governmental positions and be on a local non-profit board, the question is who will they advocate for? In a recent Commissioners meeting, we got the answer. The room was filled with citizens opposed of not only the data centers but raising our taxes. Many citizens spoke for over 2 hrs. At the end, it did not matter. They had their minds made up before we spoke and voted against us the citizens they are supposed to be working for. 
Texarkana, which consist of Bowie and Miller County, is not on ERCOTS power grid. Citizens are already receiving outrages water bills and much higher electricity bills. In fact,  local attorney Shawn Morgan is suing Texarkana Water Utilities. Some residents are facing bills up to $10,000. While the City has made some efforts since the Lawsuit to check meters we are still responsible for paying a $50 fee for them to do so. Texarkana is a struggling community. We have high crime and poverty. While the Commissioners and City have voted to raise taxes and give themselves a raise, the citizens are still left with bad roads, high utility bills, high crime, and poverty. 
In addition to higher utilities bills, citizens are worried about the oversight of these data centers. The location they are being build allows minimal governing. Who will make sure they have the proper sewage? Who will make sure they are actually paying bills? Who will make sure our land doesn’t get contaminated? Who will stop a fire should one happen? 
TexAmericas Center, where Project Big Pine and Data Hub are being built have the sole governing authority. They grant the permits, coordinate inspections and grant occupancy permits. 
As if the corruption weren’t enough. We are now facing the reality of our water, air, and land being polluted. Many of us have grown up on these lands for generations. Some have even moved back from large cities like Dallas and Austin to continue living on their grandparents/parents land.  
Furthermore, we still do not have a Fire Marshall and are relying on volunteer fire departments to help in case of a fire.
What happens if one of these data centers catches on fire? What happens when their chemicals leak into the soil? What happens when the water is contaminated and runs out?
I have recently bought land 4 miles either direction from a data center. We have livestock, a well, and a creek. Our future is now in the hands of local governments who do not do their job to protect and advocate for their citizens. 
I encourage you to investigate the City Texarkana, Hooks, New Boston,Nash, RedLick for the corruption and negligence of officials. 

Thank you. 

Yasmen Ritchey
Concerned Citizen
